newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters 1st ex-Paris Asia/Mideast air cargo report.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 1st ex-Paris Asia/Mideast air cargo report.

text.p: This report and one covering the ex-Paris market to the Americas and Africa will in future be issued alternately.
Below are current average ex-Paris French franc air cargo rates per kilo for a 100kg shipment with volume-to-weight ratio of six-to-one.
*The rates quoted in this report were obtained by Reuters on a confidential basis from a range of airlines, large forwarders and smaller cargo agents based at the Paris airports.
*All prices are quoted in French francs.
*The tariffs represent average rates calculated from a range of prices and are indicative of current market activity. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
